context_for_next_testing_agent: Field-to-Listing module fully tested. Key endpoints: (1) POST /api/field-listing/batches - create batch with name, source_vendor, grouped_pricing_note, grouped_category_note, condition_note, pickup_shipping_note, destinations. (2) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/upload-photos - multi-file upload creates item records. (3) GET /api/field-listing/images/{batch_id}/{filename} - serves uploaded images (no auth required). (4) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/apply-pricing - parses pricing notes like 'These were $25 each, sell at $55' into unit_cost=25.0, retail_price=55.0. (5) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/analyze - starts Vision AI analysis (returns job_id for polling). (6) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/generate-listings - generates listing content (returns job_id). (7) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/generate-packs - generates destination packs (website, offerup, facebook). Frontend has dashboard at /field-listing with stats, batch list, New Batch button. Batch workspace at /field-listing/{batch_id} has action bar, pricing bar, items table.
